notes.title: UPDATE v1.06.28
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785979/1ccc4a9deb62c35c7500c0c511bd8f61a5eaab99.png

Updates and bug fixes for the game.

Corrections


 Fixed: Collisions of some objects;
 Fixed: ammunition was counted incorrectly when firing;


Additions

 Added new animations
 Added boxes with ammunition to the location
 Added localization:
✔ French
✔ Italian
✔ German
✔ Spanish
✔ Turkish


Improvements

 Improved user interface.
 Improved overall game stability;


Changes

 Changed: AI of mobs has been reworked.
 Changed: game sounds.
 Changed: mobs have been rebalanced.
 Changed: Improved body physics;
 Changed: Significantly improved accuracy of all weapons;
 Changed: The characteristics of some weapons have been slightly changed;

notes.title: [Game Hotfix] - 10612
notes.content:
Minor fixes for some game bugs.

Fixes


 All versions


 Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash
 Fixed incorrect weapon animation
 Fixed display of the weapon icon during the game
 Fixed changing music volume in the main menu through sound settings
 Fixed weapon reload sound.

notes.title: [Game Hotfix] - 10531
notes.content:
A small hotfix to update official translations and fix some localizations bugs.

Fixes


 All versions


 Localization of main menu lines has been fixed.
 Fixed several invalid or unsupported characters in strings.
 Fixed a bug in the patch notes where the summary was not displayed correctly.
 Localization updated.
